summary: Created and syntax-validated the SQLite schema for Kanban tasks, including status constraints, timestamps, an index, and automatic update timestamp handling.

messages.content: schema.sql is ready and validated with SQLite. It creates the tasks table, status/trimmed-title constraints, timestamps, a status/updated_at index, and an update timestamp trigger; you may proceed with API implementation.
Database persistence work is complete in schema.sql; backend is unblocked.

decisions: Use a portable idempotent SQLite schema (`IF NOT EXISTS`) instead of a separate migration framework for this initial lightweight application.
Enforce normalized state values and nonblank 1-200 character titles at the database boundary; update `updated_at` via trigger.
